{{Top|canon=Water recycling unit}}
{{Otheruses|water}}
A '''water reprocessor''',<ref name="SL">{{JournalCite|4|Smuggler's Log}}</ref> '''water convertor''',<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> or '''water recycler'''<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref> was part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] life support systems. It reprocessed waste [[Water/Legends|water]] by filtering and purifying it, including water lost to evaporation. After several treatments, the water would develop a bland and tasteless flavor.<ref name="SL" />
